source: Course ideas Page: AI projects for UK teens (13+), prepared 15 November 2026 (Europe/London).
notes: The source inventory did not include a structured tools list per idea (tools were described as types or occasional examples because apps change). The tools array is therefore empty; tools are chosen when a course is drafted, against the Tool Register.
The source inventory did not include a per-idea minimum age. The catalogue is for ages 13–18, so minAge is 13 for every idea.

flags.age18Tools maps from the source watch-out 'age18' (common tools typically 18+). flags.safeguarding maps from the source watch-out 'safe' (a safeguarding or data note). watchNote is the original note text, or null if there was none.
suggestedForLaunch marks the 15 ideas recommended as a first set on that Page.
careers is copied from the source and is not a required brief field.
